business.title: SOUEAST C-DM Hybrid System: Adapting to Urban and Intercity Travel Needs
business.description: WUHU, China, Aug. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- As new energy vehicles continue to gain momentum worldwide, their efficiency and lower running costs have made them increasingly popular for urban commuting. However, when embarking on long journeys, new energy vehicles, particularly pure-electric models, still grapple with range anxiety. How can urban drivers balance low-cost commuting with long-range intercity travel demands? SOUEAST’s solution is the C-DM Hybrid System, a comprehensive power technology covering diverse mobility scenarios while harmonizing low energy consumption with high-performance output. On August 5, 2026, SOUEAST held its first long-distance media test drive of the S08 i-DM in Mexico, powered by the C-DM Hybrid System.
